name: Reality Distortion
slug: A doorway that stretches reality around moving objects.
description: Reality Distortion is a doorway or phenomenon that cleaves or stretches a section of reality rather than functioning as an ordinary physical door. Objects and people can pass through it, and a ship can continue moving through it without being physically stopped.

log.summary: Opening the doorway from a moving ship caused the ship and surrounding material to stretch like a rubber band. Stopping and reversing the ship reversed the direction of the stretching and sent a ripple through the ship, reinforcing that the doorway alters or stretches reality itself.
notes: Opening a doorway from a moving ship caused the ship and surrounding material to stretch like a rubber band.
Stopping and reversing the ship caused the stretching effect to reverse direction and ripple through the ship.
The doorway appears to function as a cleaved or stretched section of reality rather than an ordinary physical door.
Objects and people can pass through the doorway, and the ship itself is not physically stopped by the doorway.

openQuestions: What happens to the stretched reality when the doorway is closed?
